seoTitle: Ann Arbor Schools Calendar 2025–26: AAPS Dates
seoDescription: AAPS starts Aug. 25, 2025, and ends June 9, 2026. See half days, breaks, testing late starts, two high-school exam tracks, transitions, PDF, and .ics dates.
heroSummary: AAPS students start Monday, August 25, 2025, and finish Tuesday, June 9, 2026; both are half days. The year includes an October Early Fall Break, November Late Fall Break, separate semester and trimester exam windows, and grade-specific late starts and transition days.
calendarNotes: The first and last days are half days for all students, but families need the correct school-level release time. October 31 and March 10 are report-writing half days for elementary, K-8, and middle schools while high-school students attend a full day. May 14 narrows the half day to elementary and K-8, leaving middle and high schools full day. Community, Huron, and Pioneer use semester exams in January and June; Pathways and Skyline use trimester exams in November, March, and June. April testing dates create late starts only for the grades printed in the event. April 27 pairs an eighth-grade transition day with a high-school half day, and April 30 pairs a fifth-grade transition day with a middle-school half day. The district announcement says a return to three-tier busing shifted the elementary day five minutes to 8:50 a.m.-3:53 p.m. Preschool and A2Virtual follow slightly different calendars, so their program pages control dates outside this K-12 overview.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Ann Arbor Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: AAPS students start Monday, August 25, 2025. The first day is a half day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AAPS Winter Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025, through Friday, January 2, 2026. School resumes Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AAPS Mid-Winter Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Mid-Winter Break runs Friday, February 13, through Tuesday, February 17, 2026. School resumes Wednesday, February 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AAPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 30, through Friday, April 3, 2026. School resumes Monday, April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Which AAPS schools have trimester exams in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Pathways and Skyline use trimester exam windows November 21-25, March 4-6, and June 5 and 8-9. Community, Huron, and Pioneer use semester exam windows instead.

calendarFaqs.q: Are AAPS high schools dismissed early on March 10, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: No. March 10 is a report-writing half day for elementary, K-8, and middle schools. The official calendar says high-school students attend a full day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of AAPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Tuesday, June 9, 2026. It is a half day for all students, with release times that vary by school level.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 14, 2026, against the official revised AAPS text-only PDF, the district's two-year calendar announcement, and the official bell-schedule page.
sourceReviewDetails: The local PDF and current official direct PDF are byte-for-byte identical and share the same SHA-256 checksum.
The one-page text calendar was extracted, rendered at high resolution, and visually checked for every printed row and the preschool/A2Virtual note.
Nonconsecutive June exam dates were split rather than converted into one continuous range.
The elementary bell-time change comes from the official AAPS announcement, not from an inferred prior-year schedule.
sourceMaintainerText: Denis Dou using official Ann Arbor Public Schools sources.
